findings.source_quote: “If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you. (John 15:18)”
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the omitted final clause in Portuguese, for example: “Se o mundo vos odeia, sabei que primeiro me odiou a mim. Se a vós odia, também odiou a mim antes de odiar a vós.” Keep the reference as João 15:18.

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Meu irmão estava trabalhando na estufa”
findings.source_quote: “Some plant, some water, but God gives the increase.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a clear Portuguese rendering of the contrast, such as “Um planta, outro rega, mas Deus dá o crescimento.”
